name: dialectic-skills
description: Marketplace for the dia plugin: thirteen instruction-only reasoning-and-review skills and dia, the one skill that calls them.

plugins.name: dia
plugins.description: Thirteen reasoning-and-review skills, each a function with one purpose: showing what is asked and the result it is for before work (skopos), doing a task for its outcome with an outside check (techne), a single review pass (emend), review rounds that move only on outside evidence (ratchet), rules for text a model follows (regula), internal critique (negative), reductio, argument warrants, counterexamples to a universal claim (conjecture), counterplans, rulings on reports about a target (adjudicate), and two questioning dialogues (elenchus, quaestio); plus dia, which calls them and has a target criticised by three independent agents and judged by a fourth. A skill starts when its name starts the message.
